lines.text: The inner court's east gate stays shut on the six work days but opens on the Sabbath and the New Moon.
On the Sabbath the prince offers six unblemished lambs and a ram, and on the New Moon a young bull too.
At the appointed feasts, whoever enters by the north gate must go out by the Damascus gate.
Every morning the people provide an unblemished year-old goat as a daily burnt offering to the LORD.
In the priests' holy chambers at the far western end, the priests boil the guilt offering and sin offering and bake the grain offering.
